steps.title: Harvest and Fragment Organoids
steps.instruction: Remove medium from 3-5 fully confluent wells and break up Matrigel domes and organoids using fresh DMEM-F12 (or ice cold PBS for intestinal organoids).

substeps.instruction: Add fresh DMEM-F12 forcefully using a p1000 pipette.
Triturate organoids with a 1 mL pipettor to break up domes and fragment organoids (approximately 20 titrations for intestinal organoids).
Transfer cells to a 15mL tube by circling the well multiple times with additional media.

steps.title: Pellet and Clean Organoids
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the cells and ensure all Matrigel is removed from the pellet.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge at 300 x g for 5 minutes at room temperature (15 - 25°C).
Aspirate the supernatant without disturbing the pellet.

If a translucent pellet remains above the organoid pellet, aspirate supernatant, add fresh cold solution (e.g., DMEM/F-12), break up the pellet with a P1000 pipette, add an additional 2 mL of cold solution, and centrifuge at 300 x g for 5 min at 4°C.

steps.title: Lyse Organoid Pellets
steps.instruction: Resuspend the cleaned pellet in lysis buffer to extract RNA.

substeps.instruction: Aspirate the supernatant once Matrigel is eliminated.
Resuspend each pooled condition in 350 µL of Buffer RLT (RNeasy Mini Kit) supplemented with β-mercaptoethanol (β-ME) at a concentration of 10uL β-ME per 1mL Buffer RLT.

steps.title: Homogenize Lysate
steps.instruction: Triturate the lysate and pass it through a QIAshredder column.

substeps.instruction: Triturate the cell lysate until all visible organoid fragments are dissolved and the mixture becomes viscous, then slightly less viscous.
Transfer the entire lysate volume to a QIAshredder spin column in a 2 mL collection tube.
Centrifuge the spin column at 10,000 x g for 2 minutes at room temperature.
Discard the spin column and cap the collection tube.

steps.title: Store or Process Lysate
steps.instruction: Transfer the homogenized lysate to labeled collection tubes on ice. If not using immediately, store the sample at -80°C (stable for up to 6 months).

steps.title: Prepare Lysate for Column
steps.instruction: Add 1 volume of 70% ethanol to the homogenized lysate and mix well by pipetting. Do not centrifuge.

steps.title: Bind RNA to Spin Column
steps.instruction: Transfer the sample to an RNeasy spin column in a 2 ml collection tube.

substeps.instruction: Transfer up to 700 μl of the sample (including any precipitate) to the column.
Centrifuge for 15 s at ≥8000 x g (≥10,000 rpm).
Discard the flow-through, keeping the collection tube.
If sample volume exceeds 700 μl, centrifuge successive aliquots in the same column, discarding flow-through after each step.

steps.title: Wash Spin Column
steps.instruction: Perform sequential washes of the spin column membrane.

substeps.instruction: Add 700 μl Buffer RW1, centrifuge for 15 s at ≥8000 x g (≥10,000 rpm), and discard flow-through.
Add 500 μl Buffer RPE, centrifuge for 15 s at ≥8000 x g (≥10,000 rpm), and discard flow-through.
Add 500 μl Buffer RPE again, centrifuge for 2 min at ≥8000 x g (≥10,000 rpm) to wash the membrane.

steps.title: Dry Spin Column
steps.instruction: Remove residual ethanol from the membrane.

substeps.instruction: Place the RNeasy spin column in a new 2 ml collection tube and discard the old tube.
Centrifuge at full speed for 1 min.

steps.title: Elute RNA
steps.instruction: Elute the purified RNA into a clean collection tube.

substeps.instruction: Place the RNeasy spin column in a new 1.5 ml collection tube.
Add 30–50 μl RNAse-free water directly to the spin column membrane.
Centrifuge for 1 min at ≥8000 x g (≥10,000 rpm) to elute the RNA.
